segments.name: controller
segments.covers: Controller-private feature logic: fleet management, orchestration and the controller services under features/controller.
segments.cannot_see: Shared packages under pkg/, steward-side logic, and cross-component feature packages (features-shared).

segments.name: steward
segments.covers: Steward-private feature logic: the convergence loop and endpoint-side operations under features/steward.
segments.cannot_see: Shared packages under pkg/, controller-side logic, and cross-component feature packages (features-shared).

segments.name: workflow
segments.covers: The workflow engine and its execution logic under features/workflow.
segments.cannot_see: Modules the engine invokes, shared packages under pkg/, and controller services that host the engine.

segments.name: modules
segments.covers: Module implementations under features/modules, including stdlib and extended modules.
segments.cannot_see: The module runtime and packaging in pkg/, and the steward or controller code that invokes modules.

segments.name: pkg
segments.covers: Shared packages and central providers under pkg/, plus non-generated Go under api/.
segments.cannot_see: Feature logic under features/, command wiring under cmd/, and generated protobuf code (excluded from measurement).

segments.name: cmd
segments.covers: Command entry points under cmd/: controller, steward, cfg and the other binaries.
segments.cannot_see: The logic these commands call into under pkg/ and features/.

segments.name: features-shared
segments.covers: Cross-component feature packages shared by controller and steward.
segments.cannot_see: Component-private logic in features/controller and features/steward.
